document_package_ready.name: document_package_ready
document_package_ready.value: ("document_package"."status" = 'READY') = ("document_package"."manifest_hash" is not null and "document_package"."ready_at" is not null)

backup_job_ready.name: backup_job_ready
backup_job_ready.value: ("backup_job"."status" <> 'READY') or ("backup_job"."size" is not null and "backup_job"."sha256" is not null and "backup_job"."storage_key" is not null and "backup_job"."expires_at" is not null)

system_backup_done.name: system_backup_done
system_backup_done.value: ("system_backup"."status" <> 'SUCCEEDED') or ("system_backup"."size" is not null and "system_backup"."sha256" is not null and "system_backup"."storage_key" is not null)
